rounds.text: Angel Fibers Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a 26.1% margin of safety identified by discounted cash flow analysis [E42, E43]. The company is fundamentally undervalued relative to its assets, as evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 0.76x [E2, E49]. Financial health is improving through active deleveraging, with borrowings falling from Rs 34 Cr to Rs 26 Cr over the past year [E37, E48]. Operational efficiency is supported by strong cash generation, where operating cash flow of Rs 11 Cr and free cash flow of Rs 13 Cr demonstrate that profits are fully backed by actual cash [E33, E34, E35]. Furthermore, the company is benefiting from a sector-wide tailwind, and recent quarterly results show margin expansion of 2 percentage points compared to the year-ago period [E30, E59, E63]. Conceded: the company has a low return on equity [E51, E61], pays no dividends [E4, E50], and promoters have pledged 28.7% of their holdings [E54].
